diagrams.name: evidence-constellation-trace
diagrams.title: One governed decision, traced from case to replay
diagrams.alt: Eight-step flow for fictional case C04. 1, synthetic case: no successful delivery for 20 hours. 2, retrieved evidence: 7 records. 3, advisory decision: no attention advised, score 0.153 below threshold 0.16, while the generator's own risk is 0.376. 4, simulated policy rule P3 sends it to a human. 5, simulated approval not given. 6, receipt validator INCOMPLETE: source signatures not verified, clock not NTP-synced, no RFC 3161 time token. 7, replay structurally consistent, not authenticated. 8, live action blocked.

diagrams.name: tamper-lab-verdicts
diagrams.title: Four forgeries per receipt: three are caught, one is not
diagrams.alt: Grid of 9 fictional cases by 5 receipt copies. Every genuine copy is structurally consistent but unsigned. The T1, T2 and T4 forgeries are caught in all 27 cells. Every T3 full-rewrite forgery passes (9 cells), because the receipts are unsigned.

diagrams.name: replay-check-mutation-coverage
diagrams.title: Every replay check is shown to catch something
diagrams.alt: Matrix of 6 replay checks by 8 forgeries. Forcing any single check to pass changes at least one forgery's verdict: 6 of 6 mutants killed. The page's own four forgeries make 2 of the 6 checks load-bearing; harness forgeries X2 to X5 cover the rest. T3 is never caught.

diagrams.name: oac-baselines-and-ceiling
diagrams.title: The audited model against two baselines and its generator's ceiling
diagrams.alt: Two panels for oac-system-health-v1 on its 240-row synthetic test split. Panel a compares an always-majority predictor, the rule consecutive_failures > 0 and the model, with bootstrap 95% intervals. Panel b shows the model's ROC AUC 0.830 against the generator's own ceiling of 0.841.
